stem: Humidity spikes occur only inside dense canopy sections after lights-off, while room-wall RH stays acceptable. Which evidence best supports the next diagnostic direction?
choices: The room average proves there is no problem
Interior canopy measurements suggest a spatial mixing/moisture-load issue worth investigating
The cultivar name determines the cause
The only solution is more fertilizer
rationale: Localized nighttime humidity in dense canopy sections points toward spatial airflow/mixing and moisture-load behavior.
